description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Break the Anchor against every Named target present at once, in a single action.

Break the Anchor against every Named creature you can perceive, resolving each separately at full effect. Each target's own defences and saves apply as they normally would; where your Ward's Break the Anchor requires a hit, make one Strike roll and apply its result to each target separately, with no multiple attack penalty between them.
